purpose: Operational truths about THIS environment. Read at session start so no session re-learns these the hard way. When you discover a new durable fact about how the setup behaves, add it here.

git.push_new_branch: git push to a NEW branch WORKS (ref creation is allowed).
git.main_protected: main is branch-protected — direct push, force-push, and branch delete to main return HTTP 403.
git.path_to_main: branch -> PR -> merge via GitHub MCP (mcp__github__create_pull_request then merge_pull_request, squash). This is the only way to land on main. Precedent: PR #16/#17/#18/#19.
git.never: do not force-push or delete remote branches — both 403. Do not assume push is fully blocked; only main updates are.

frontend.file: docs/index.html — single ~147KB file, ONE giant inline <script>.
frontend.fragility: a single JS syntax error (e.g. a duplicate top-level const) halts the ENTIRE app — blank on load, no partial degradation.
frontend.guard: ALWAYS run node --check on the extracted inline script before committing docs/index.html. CI enforces this: .github/workflows/js-parse-check.yml.
frontend.too_big_to_read: exceeds the Read tool token limit. Target sections by line number / grep; never read the whole file.
frontend.deploy: GitHub Pages serves docs/ on main; rebuild takes ~1 min after merge. Hard-refresh to bust cache.

supabase.edge_fn_service_key: in edge functions use Deno.env SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY ?? SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (platform-injected fallback — always available).
supabase.writes: browser is read-only via the anon key; ALL browser writes go through the grid-write proxy (service role, whitelisted table+op). P34.
supabase.verify_jwt: grid-event and grid-write run with verify_jwt:false (public gates with their own validation). Preserve this on redeploy.
supabase.rls: anon SELECT is open (public read). anon write policies are being removed table-by-table — P34 phase 2.

sandbox.network: this execution sandbox CANNOT curl supabase.co or arbitrary hosts (host allowlist -> 'Host not in allowlist').
sandbox.use_instead: Supabase MCP tools (execute_sql, deploy_edge_function, apply_migration, get_advisors) reach the project; raw curl/fetch from the shell does not.
sandbox.verification: edge functions can't be invoked from the sandbox. Verify behavior via the live site + execute_sql row checks (compare counts/timestamps before and after).

embeddings: OpenAI-compatible — text-embedding-3-small, 1536-dim, via EMBEDDING_API_KEY. NOT Jina (removed in da986f4), NOT Ollama.
gotchas: A duplicate top-level 'const GNPL={}' in docs/index.html silently broke the whole app from P29 until 2026-05-29 (fixed b50f63a). node --check would have caught it instantly — that is why the CI gate exists.
patch_ledger.json is the LIVING tracker and drifts. Sync it when work lands (P30 and P33 were both stale before the 2026-05-29 audit).
README must stay cloud-first. It previously described the old local-first / Ollama / SQLite design and misled fresh agents — rewritten 2026-05-29.
Forbidden God-System edges: SKADI->AEGIS, DANTE->SKADI, JANUS->SKADI, LOKI->HADES. The grid-event AEGIS gate enforces these.
